styleReferenceEnabled.label: Studio — style/pose reference
styleReferenceEnabled.help: Off by default. Turn this on so a generation can follow a real sample pose or styling image the owner supplies for it. Supplying one is always optional; a photo that is archived, AI-generated, or tagged for a different job is ignored rather than guessed at. The resulting pose set or video is reused for the same template, product and colours, never paid for twice.
